# Production heavy-scene memory soak plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: superpowers:executing-plans inline on the existing authorized branch; one fresh final review.

**Goal:** Determine whether repeated Alkaid/W26 runs retain scene resources or grow collected heap/buffer storage after returning to the menu.

**Architecture:** Reuse the immutable current production build and its existing connection/view helper. Add an external bounded camera exercise and collect native Chrome CDP memory measurements outside timed windows. Keep raw evidence, verify restoration, and investigate any trend before calling it a leak.

**Tech Stack:** Installed Three/TypeScript app, frozen Vite production preview, Playwright native Chrome, installed CDP types, Node evidence verifier.

**Spec:** Continuing user-authorized audit/fixes, docs/project-audit-2026-10-21.md performance item16, open long-memory coverage. Earlier heavy soak used development mode and only10seconds per visit. Preserve quality and record findings in the existing repository audit.

## Global constraints

- BASE83976aef4e5110bad3f5f5b3914c67a6ea5a841f, branch codex/audit-fixes-2026-10-21. Current source equals c00a4de4 production inputs. Local commit only, no automatic push.
- Use immutable volume-batch-dist-2026-10-27; validate32buildfiles and source inputs before/after. No source-module imports or production quality/code changes for diagnosis.
- Serial GPU/heavy runs. Full run: one warmup visit15s per scene, then6rounds x2scenes x60s=12minutes measured motion; smoke one5s visit per scene. Load/view/settle/GC/menu idle are additional time, not measured motion.
- Camera repeats a bounded2TU lateral excursion and360degree yaw per visit, with existing belt-view setup. Record actual trajectory and streamers; do not claim unmeasured sector churn or all trajectories.
- Sample Runtime.getHeapUsage (used,total,embedder,backing storage), Performance metrics and DOM counters after explicit GC outside windows, active and after menu. Treat these as isolate/process-domain indicators, not renderer VRAM bytes.
- Resource gates: after menu1geometry/0textures/0programs,empty registries/bake queues,one session canvas/context. Heap trends are observations, not an arbitrary absolute leak threshold. Warmup separate; compare same scenes and post-GC endpoints.
- Preserve errors/warnings/aborted requests and failed attempts. No broad suppression. GPU context loss or scene failure invalidates the run.
- If actual retention/growth is found, localize owners with targeted evidence, extend the plan with specific RED/GREEN regressions before application edits, then run appropriate full checks and paired production validation. No speculative fix.

## Review focus

1. Instrumentation retains no scene/mesh/history objects across unload; bounded numeric samples and Node-side results only. Restore camera and renderFrame descriptors on success/failure.
2. GC/CDP reads occur outside frame windows; resource counts versus bytes and active versus menu measurements remain distinct. Forced-GC results do not certify normal scheduling or VRAM.
3. Same page/runtime/renderer/context across visits; all loads are real production assets. Warmup, caches, delayed disposal and changes in workload are visible.
4. Frame/phase/round accounting, timestamps, source/build identity and reported quantiles/trends must independently reproduce from raw records.
5. Limited duration/device/routes and unresolved long-frame causes remain explicit. Flat menu counts alone do not establish universal leak freedom.

### Task 1: Run and analyze a bounded production memory soak

**Files:** create ignored benchmark-results/heavy-scenes/production-memory-soak-2026-10-28.browser.js, run-production-memory-soak-2026-10-28.mjs and archive verifier; create docs/benchmarks/production-memory-soak-2026-10-28.json; extend audit under item16 (not a duplicate new item number).

**Interfaces:** window.__connectMemorySoak(runtimeUrl); snapshot(); exercise({durationMs,periodMs=60000,spanTu=2}); restore(). Reuse __productionFrame.connect/selectScenario/setView/menu/settle read-only. Runner report includes scene/phase/round, measured raw frame starts/durations, periodic numeric snapshots, pre/post-active GC, post-menu GC, network/diagnostics and provenance.

- [x] Inspect existing soak/disposal and installed CDP API; implement diagnostic only, then smoke both scenes. Expected: native GPU, actual rendering, one reused context, restored wrappers, complete samples and all menu gates.
- [x] Run warmup and12measured visits serially. Save incremental report after each visit; preserve raw intervals and numeric counters. Expected: completed coverage or an explicitly retained failed report, no omitted errors.
- [x] Recalculate same-scene GC trends and frame quantiles, check backing storage/DOM/resource counts. If growth appears, first test delayed cleanup or owner-retention hypotheses; no leak claim solely from a slope.
- [x] If a reproducible application defect exists, extend plan with concrete fix/test files, observe RED->GREEN and run full relevant validation. Otherwise keep application unchanged and do not repeat unchanged full suites.
- [x] Archive evidence, sources, failures, hashes and limitations; update audit, verify, local commit, one fresh review and rule on every declined boundary. Preserve/delete only this plan's scratch workspace after completion.

Self-review: one coupled diagnostic task. Known intent/constraints and established destination make another questionnaire or workflow menu unnecessary. No new product feature or code change is assumed.

## Follow-up triggered by collected JS heap growth

The long run shows stable resource/DOM/backing-storage counts but modest JS heap growth. Before attributing it to the application, run `run-production-memory-retainers-2026-10-28.mjs` serially after the main soak: warm both scenes15s,12idle diagnostic-only GC/sample controls in the same menu,heap snapshot before,4alternating15svisits with retained-allocation sampling,10sidle and heap snapshot after. Preserve all raw snapshots and inspect size/count deltas plus actual retainer paths. Compare generic code/string/runtime growth with application objects; no fix until a concrete owner is established. This is a follow-up diagnosis,not another performance benchmark.

## Render-list retention investigation and conditional fix

The after snapshot contains a path from the live session Scene through the renderer render-list WeakMap to an unloaded asteroid system. Installed Three retains the last frame's items until another render or renderLists.dispose(). Engine.dispose currently empties the scene and stops drawing without resetting those lists. Run the causal diagnostic `run-production-render-list-release-2026-10-28.mjs`: four alternating real-scene visits, inspect post-menu list counts, release only renderLists, and compare collected memory in the same page. Preserve the original soak as the unmodified baseline.

If the diagnostic confirms this owner, extend Task1 with these steps:
- Add a meaningful regression in tests/EngineDispose.spec.ts using Three's actual WebGLRenderLists and scene/geometry/material objects. Populate opaque/transparent/transmissive lists at multiple render depths, unload, assert that querying the session renderer no longer returns those objects, and verify a later scenario can populate/release again. Observe failure before the application edit.
- In src/core/Engine.ts dispose the session renderer's render lists after scene/postprocessing teardown and before the final animation-loop stop. Keep renderer/context ownership unchanged. Update renderer test doubles if they exercise disposal.
- Run the targeted regression RED/GREEN, typecheck/full unit suite, lint, production build, native browser suite and the SwiftShader production startup plus the two existing volume-batch checks serially.
- Freeze a distinct candidate production build and rerun the same real-scene menu measurements. Require empty lists automatically, reused renderer/context, successful reloads and reduced collected storage; no manual cleanup in candidate measurements. Record exact source/build identities and retain both before/after evidence.

Candidate build v1 was rejected: the executor omitted explicit cloud/stats environment values,causing missing local assets. Preserve its failed report and frozen build. Candidate v2 pins VITE_FS_DRIVER=s3,VITE_S3_URL=https://storage.yandexcloud.net,VITE_FILE_BUCKET=textures,VITE_SHOW_STATS_PANEL=false,VITE_SKY_SOURCE=gaia,matching the documented baseline build. Resource gates stay unchanged; v2 also retains selected GPU/viewport and actual exercise data per visit.
